newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Jan-Nov vehicle sales drop 11.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Jan-Nov vehicle sales drop 11.6 pct.

text.p: New vehicle sales fell 11.6 percent in Colombia between January and November compared to the same period last year, industry sources said Monday.

In the first 11 months of this year, sales of commercial and private vehicles dropped to 107,100 compared to 121,198 in the same period in 1995, according to a statement by the General Motors-Colmotores assembly plant.
Sales of commercial vehicles showed the biggest drop, down 12.5 percent to 39,508, while car sales dipped 11.2 percent to 67,592.
Only two manufacturers saw an upturn in sales. Ford Motor Co increased 23.8 percent, while Nissan Motor Co Ltd sales increased 8.6 percent.
The figures include data from Mazda Motor Corp assembler Compania Colombiana Authomotriz, Renault SA assembler Sociedad de Fabricacion Automotriz and estimates of imported vehicles.
